name: postonce
description: Write a native post for every social platform, crosspost it to LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest in one request, and schedule content calendars, through each platform's official API.

interface.shortDescription: Social media skills and publishing for 9 platforms.
interface.longDescription: Post-everywhere, content calendar, hook vault and viral formats skills, plus publishing, scheduling and automatic crossposting to 9 platforms. Publishing goes through each platform's official API, via PostOnce.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this blog post into native posts for all my connected accounts and schedule them for tomorrow at 9am.
